generation.scope: Any branching window of opposite rank eight without surface projections has a forward or backward center with a two-dimensional middle support, even with pure relations. At rank nine, in the absence of such a center, every center has middle support three and the general point of its fiber line has middle support four. The primitive kernel degree bounds the loss in middle rank by local elementary divisors.
